figures.caption: Fig. 1. Queue lengths (left) and per-agent opinions (right) over time for 10 anti-cooperative agents. 6 agents lack queue imbalance information. Agents polarize quickly, do not switch queues, and easily settle in N .

Fig. 2. Queue lengths (left) and per-agent opinions (right) over time for 10 fully-cooperative agents when 6 agents lack imbalance information. After initial herding near t = 4 where all agents end up in A, the agents rapidly settle into two distinct groups based on their access to imbalance information.
